marks.gloss_en: והלכתא: כיון שהתחיל, שוב אינו פוסק
Rav (via Rav Chananel): one counts twenty-one days, as one counts ten days from Rosh HaShana to Yom Kippur, and begins
once one has begun [mentioning], one no longer stops
until when does one request rain? R' Yehuda: until Pesach has passed
כתיב הכא: מוסר הבלים עץ הוא, וכתיב התם: הבל המה מעשה תעתעים -- 'hevel' of idols there, so the 'one' that burns the wicked here is idolatry
[RN: Jer 10:8?] R' Yochanan: 'one' is the sin that burns the wicked in Gehinnom -- idolatry; 'hevel' here (Jer 10:8) and 'hevel' there of idols (Jer 10:15)
יורה בניסן? יורה במרחשון הוא! דתנן: יורה במרחשון ומלקוש בניסן
הכי אמר רבי יוחנן: in Joel's days this verse was fulfilled -- that year the first rain fell on 1 Nisan (= p_bimei_yoel_nitkayem, p_ravia_rishona_benisan)
the first rain is in Marcheshvan and the last rain in Nisan
ומי איכא ירושלים למעלה? -- is there a Jerusalem above at all?
אין, דכתיב: ירושלים הבנויה כעיר שחברה לה יחדו (= p_yesh_yerushalayim_lemaala)
the stam: yes, there is a Jerusalem above, as it is written 'Jerusalem built as a city joined together' (Ps 122:3)
the prophet told Israel to go and sow; they asked whether one with a kav of wheat or two of barley should eat and live or sow and die; he said: nevertheless go and sow
they sowed on the 2nd-4th, the second rainfall came on the 5th of Nisan, and the omer on the 16th came from grain that grew in eleven days instead of six months
of that generation it says: 'they who sow in tears shall reap in joy; he goes weeping, bearing the measure of seed' (Ps 126:5-6)
[the stam asks the meaning of 'bearing his sheaves'] the stalk was a span and the ear two spans

[RN: in the seven years of famine (II Kings 8:1), what did they eat?] R' Yochanan: year by year -- what was in the houses, the fields, clean animals, unclean animals, vermin, their children, and in the seventh the flesh of their own arms

[RN: 'it is holy in your midst, and I will not enter the city' (Hosea 11:9) -- because it is holy He will not enter?] R' Yochanan: the Holy One said: I will not enter Jerusalem above until I enter Jerusalem below
